variables.input:
fetch logs, from:$dt_timeframe_from
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| dedup user
| fields user

fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| lookup [fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source == "alstom/audit/users"
], sourcefield: user, lookupfield:email
| expand lookup.groups
| summarize count(), by:{lookup.groups}
| filter lookup.groups != "Default group with all users"
| fields lookup.groups

data record( host.name="ANY")
| append [timeseries avg(dt.sfm.active_gate.jvm.cpu_usage), 
  by: { dt.active_gate.group.name, dt.network_zone.id, host.name, dt.active_gate.id }

// add extra columns to deal with null/default dimensions
| fieldsAdd instance= if($SplitByInstance == "Yes", host.name, else: null)
| fieldsAdd networkzone = if(isNull(dt.network_zone.id), "default", else: dt.network_zone.id)
| fieldsAdd group = if(isNull(dt.active_gate.group.name), "default", else: dt.active_gate.group.name)

// apply filtering by variables
| filter if($NetworkZone == "ANY", true, else: $NetworkZone == networkzone)
| filter if($Group == "ANY", true, else: $Group == group) 
| filter if($InstanceId == "ANY", true, else: $InstanceId == dt.active_gate.id) 
| dedup instance
| fields instance

]

data record(dt.active_gate.group.name="ANY")
| append [

timeseries avg(dt.sfm.active_gate.jvm.cpu_usage), 
  by: { dt.active_gate.group.name, dt.network_zone.id  }
| fieldsAdd networkzone = if(isNull(dt.network_zone.id), "default", else: dt.network_zone.id)
| filter in($NetworkZone, "ANY") OR in(networkzone,$NetworkZone)
| dedup dt.active_gate.group.name
| fields dt.active_gate.group.name

]

8.title: Logins Over the Time

| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"

30.title: Users who Logged In
30.description:
Note on Login vs Logout Counts:
The number of logout events exceeds login events because the system may log multiple logout actions per session or user. This can happen due to:

- Session timeouts or automatic logouts triggered by inactivity.
- Manual logouts across different devices or browser tabs.
- System-level logouts during maintenance or updates.
- Duplicate logout entries caused by retries or network issues.
30.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| fields user
| dedup user

31.title: Users Performing Logout
31.description: If you don't see any user email that means users have not clicked on Sign Out button from the UI. All Logouts are done automatically by system due to session management
31.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"

| dedup user
